text.body: cidambaraṃ śrīnaṭarājastutī || namaste rūdra manyava utota iṣave namaḥ | namaste astu dhanvane karābhyāṃ te namo namaḥ || 1|| yāte rudra śivā tanūḥ śāntā tasyai namo namaḥ | namo'stu nīlagrīvāya sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ || 2|| sahasrapāṇaye tubhyaṃ mīḍhuṣṭamāya te namaḥ | kapardine namastubhyaṃ kālarūpāya te namaḥ || 3|| namaste cāttaśastrāya namaste śūlapāṇaye | hiraṇyapāṇaye tubhyaṃ hiraṇyapataye namaḥ || 4|| namaste vṛkṣarūpāya harikeśāya te namaḥ | paśūnāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ pathīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || 5|| puṣṭānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | ātatāvisvarūpāya vanānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 6|| rohitāya stapataye vṛkṣāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ | namaste mantriṇe sākṣāt kakṣāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ || 7|| oṣadhīnāṃ ca pataye namaḥ sākṣātparātmane | uccairghoṣāya devāya pattīnāṃ pataye namaḥ || 8|| satvānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ ghanānāṃ pataye namaḥ | sahamānāya śāntāya śaṅkarāya namo namaḥ || 9|| ādhīnāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ vyādhīnaṃ pataye namaḥ | kakubhāya namastubhyaṃ namaste'stu niṣaṅgiṇe || 10|| stenānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ dhanānāṃ pataye namaḥ | taskarāṇāṃ namastubhyaṃ pataye pāpahāriṇe || 11|| vañcate parivañcate stāyūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | namo nicerave tubhyaṃ araṇyānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 12|| uṣṇīṣiṇe namastubhyaṃ namaste paramātmane | vistṛtāya namastubhyaṃ āsīnāya namonamaḥ || 13|| śayanāya namstubhyaṃ suṣuptāya namo namaḥ | prabuddhāya namastubhyaṃ sthirāya paramātmane || 14|| sabhārūpāya te nityaṃ sabhāyāḥ pataye namaḥ | namaḥ śivāya sāmbāya brahmaṇe sarvasākṣiṇe || 15|| || iti sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ muktikāṇḍe sabhāpatistutiḥ sampūrṇam ||
